newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT, according to analysts.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. June discount to cash but cash markets are slipping.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Strong tone to live and lower corn futures call.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Pork demand slow but packers have to pay up for light hog marketings.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Cash bellies remain strong, at highest level since mid August.
